title: Intuition Retreat
heading: Book your place and choose your room

programme.name: Programme fee
programme.summary: A week at ASHA with Amy Rachelle, ND, co-founder of Alchemy of Breath and ASHA: discover your intuitive gifts, learn to trust them and put them to work for your greater purpose, with an optional detox alongside.
programme.about: PLACEHOLDER fee (same as BreathCamp): confirm the 2027 Intuition Retreat price. Paid per guest at booking, in full, alongside the room deposit. Guests who already paid it elsewhere book their room only via ?programme=paid; the server tries to match an earlier programme-fee payment in Stripe by email and the dashboard flags anything it can't match.
includes: The whole retreat with Amy Rachelle, ND
Practices to discover your gifts and use them for your greater purpose
An optional detox during the week

price_note: One programme fee of €888 per person covers the whole retreat. Rooms are priced per person for 6 nights with all meals at ASHA.
stay_includes: 6 nights at ASHA in the room or tent you choose
Three plant-based meals a day, cooked on site, with dietary needs cared for
Coffee, tea and water throughout the day
not_included: Travel to ASHA and ground transport
Optional treatments such as massage or intuitive readings

deposit.balance_note: The rest of your accommodation is paid before you arrive at ASHA.
deposit.about: balance_due: optional YYYY-MM-DD shown as the balance due date (null = 'before you arrive'). available_until: optional YYYY-MM-DD after which only paying in full is offered.

payment_plan.note: Charged automatically to the same card each month.
payment_plan.about: last_payment_by: "before_arrival" (the day before the start date), a YYYY-MM-DD date, or null for no limit. The plan is only offered while every payment falls on or before that day.

payment_methods.about: Stripe payment_method_types per checkout mode. Methods not activated in the Stripe Dashboard are dropped automatically (falls back to card).

source.note: EXAMPLE 2027 dates from the owner (2026-10-07). Rooms, room prices, inventory, deposit, plan and payment methods are copied from breathcamp-jul-2027-1 (same venue and physical rooms; the rooms are shared with every programme that overlaps these nights). Programme fee €888 and programme spaces 49 are placeholders. Copy summarised from the Intuition Retreat entry in calendar/index.html; confirm what the week includes with Amy.

rooms.name: Twin Room Ensuite
rooms.summary: Two single beds and a private bathroom, shared only by the two people in the room (same gender).
rooms.description: With two single beds to a room, these rooms have a private bathroom that only the two people in the room share, with their own gender. This accommodation is rustic, unique, and cozy. Pricing is per person.

rooms.name: Twin Room, Shared Bathroom
rooms.summary: Two single beds in a newly renovated three-bedroom cottage with its own living room and kitchen.
rooms.description: Two single beds to a room, shared with the same gender, in a private cottage. The bathroom is shared between four people who may be of mixed gender. This beautiful three-bedroom cottage has its own living room and kitchen, and is newly renovated. Pricing is per person.

rooms.name: Shared Room for Three, Ensuite
rooms.summary: Three single beds with the room's own bathroom, in a cottage or the Main House.
rooms.description: Each room with three single beds has its own private bathroom. The beds are typically a metre apart, and the room is shared with the same gender. These rooms are in either a private cottage or the Main House. Pricing is per person.

rooms.name: Single Glamping, ASHA Bell Tent
rooms.summary: Your own bell tent with a single mattress and a sitting area, close to nature.
rooms.description: Guests love our bell tents. Single tents are furnished with a single mattress and a sitting area. They are lovely, and so very close to nature. Toilets and showers are close to your tent. Summer nights in Tuscany are warm, and mornings can be cool.

rooms.name: Twin Glamping, ASHA Bell Tent
rooms.summary: A bell tent with two mattresses, shared by two people.
rooms.description: Guests love our bell tents. Twin tents are furnished with two mattresses and shared by two people. They are lovely, and so very close to nature. Toilets and showers are close to your tent. Summer nights in Tuscany are warm, and mornings can be cool. Pricing is per person.

rooms.name: Come in a Camper
rooms.summary: Bring your camper and enjoy full use of ASHA's facilities.
rooms.description: Campers are welcome at ASHA. Space is limited, so we suggest booking as soon as you can: this is one of our most popular options. You're welcome to use all of our facilities. Would you like to bring a guest? Message us on WhatsApp.

rooms.name: Bring Your Own Tent
rooms.summary: Pitch your own tent in our secluded woods.
rooms.description: Pitch your own tent in our secluded woods, with full use of our facilities. Be sure to bring your own tent, bedding, and anything else you may need. Summer nights in Tuscany are warm, and mornings can be cool.

rooms.name: Private Single Room Ensuite
rooms.summary: A private room with its own bathroom in the Main House.
rooms.description: Enjoy a private room with its own bathroom in the Main House. It's perfect for one person, with its own single bed and a desk. In your own private oasis, rest, process, and be in your own space.

rooms.name: Private Cottage for One
rooms.summary: A cozy private cottage, all to yourself.
rooms.description: Cozy private cottage accommodation for one person, offering comfort, privacy, and a peaceful stay.

rooms.name: Private Cottage for Two
rooms.summary: A two-room cottage facing an open field. The price covers both guests.
rooms.description: A two-room cottage in a private house facing an open field, with a cozy living room, kitchen, private bathroom, and a double pull-out sofa bed. Ideal for couples, families, or anyone who wants space. The price is for the whole cottage and covers two guests.

points: We do not offer refunds. Your booking is for the Intuition Retreat at ASHA and can't be moved to another location.
If we cancel the Intuition Retreat, we refund the full amount, minus currency exchange and bank fees.
policy.change_note: With at least 45 days' notice before the start, we'll do our best to move you to another date at ASHA in the same season, if there's space. Email info@asha.global with the subject DATE CHANGE REQUEST.
policy.health_note: The Intuition Retreat is not a substitute for medical or psychological treatment. If you are managing a physical or mental health condition, or plan to do the optional detox, please consult your doctor, and mention it to our team, before attending.
policy.source: Adapted from the BreathCamp terms (https://alchemyofbreath.com/terms-and-conditions/#breathcamp-policy, updated 1 Dec 2025); there is no programme-specific terms section yet, so terms_url points at the BreathCamp policy. Confirm before going live.

arrival.checkin: Sunday 11 July, 2:30–5:00 pm, with orientation at 4:30 pm
arrival.checkout: Saturday 17 July, 8:00–9:30 am; the programme ends with lunch around 2 pm
arrival.travel: Fly into Rome Fiumicino (FCO), about 2.5 hours away by car, or take the train to Chiusi-Chianciano Terme, about an hour from ASHA. A WhatsApp group helps everyone share rides.
arrival.source: Times copied from the BreathCamp arrival (breathcamps/index.html FAQ) as a placeholder: confirm this programme's check-in and check-out.

hosts.line: Co-founder of Alchemy of Breath and ASHA. A naturopath and medical medium who brings breath, intuition, the body and voice together.

facts: Led by ASHA co-founder Amy Rachelle
Summer at ASHA: pool, creeks and the Tuscan hills
